name: rosselli-mask-border
description: A repeating Renaissance border of alternating human masks and leafy scrolls.

provenance.title: Sheet of border segments: vertical floral ornament, horizontal frieze, four corners

repeat_note: One full human-mask and foliate-scroll cycle; the original print visibly repeats this alternation four times.
usage_notes: Native phase crop from the approved AI-assisted historical extraction; interior pixels are unchanged. Only a two-pixel join collar is averaged.
Corners are modern AI-assisted foliate adaptations with exact connecting profiles, not recovered historical motifs. Use the supplied atlas with round fitting.
PNG/WebP only: no vector redraw is supplied.

review.notes: Complete motif cycle and original whole strip/reference retained. Corners are modern AI-assisted foliate adaptations; all four turns reviewed on light/dark. Straight atlas edges and native repeats retain their original pixels; 12px connecting collars remain exact.

corner_edit.method: four separately refined corner phases from source-derived miter atlas
corner_edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied transparent square Renaissance engraved frame atlas. Refine ONLY its four corner squares. Each corner square occupies 32.53012% of the image width and height. Keep the exact square canvas, empty transparent central square, border thickness, layout, all four straight edge strips, all human masks in those strips, the engraving's brown-gray linework and pale tan motif surfaces unchanged. At each corner, replace the rigid diagonal mirrored leaf splice with a graceful coherent ninety-degree acanthus-scroll turn composed from the SAME existing leaves, tendrils and scrolls. Preserve the connecting stems where the corner meets the adjacent straight edges, especially the outermost twenty pixels at those connecting sides. Do not add rosettes, geometric diamonds, unrelated flowers, human faces, masks or other motifs. Avoid cut-off leaf lobes, fused leaves and dense mirrored knots at the turns. Preserve the antique engraved style, restrained fine hatching, original light brown/cream palette, opaque motif interiors and truly transparent spaces between them. Match all four corners to their own adjacent edge phases rather than blindly rotating one corner. Return the complete unchanged-size square atlas without added margins, labels, backdrop or shadow. The artistic change should be confined to four coherent, flowing foliate corner turns.
corner_edit.assembly: premultiplied-alpha feather; original zero-weight collars and every straight edge retained byte-for-byte
corner_edit.review: accepted: all four corner phases inspected at native size on light/dark; exact connecting profiles; straight edges and repeat units unchanged
